speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what is the availability of cat breeding locations for rent from the Animal and Veterinary Service (AVS); and (b) how does AVS deal with the cats seized from illegal breeders.

speaker: The Minister of State for National Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: This is to safeguard animal health and welfare.

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
text: One, will the Animal and Veterinary Service (AVS) allow the breeder to visit the cats, even after they are seized by the AVS?

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
text: Second question, from now on, will the AVS put in a more detailed regulatory framework to allow for small breeders to continue their business?

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
text: And three, is the Animal Lodge the only place currently available for potential breeders to run their business?

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I think the Animal Lodge is in Tengah; that is what I have been told.

speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai (Non-Constituency Member)
text: And that is the only place that breeders are allowed to breed the animals, I heard.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: The other supplementary question is about the regulatory framework.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: It is something that we continue to look at.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: If Members have any feedback, they can share them with me and email us.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: At this moment, we feel that it is adequate.

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: [Pursuant to Standing Order No 22(3), provided that Members had not asked for questions standing in their names to be postponed to a later Sitting day or withdrawn, written answers to questions not reached by the end of Question Time are reproduced in the Appendix.]
